group.title: A quieter place to work
group.passage:
Harbor Library Member Update

Following a survey of members, Harbor Library is converting the former map room into a quiet workspace. Construction will begin on June 3 and is expected to last two weeks. The map collection has already been moved to the second-floor reference area, where it remains [135] ____ during normal opening hours.

The new room will contain twelve desks, each equipped with a power outlet and an adjustable lamp. Members may reserve a desk online for up to three hours per day. Telephone calls and group discussions will not be permitted. [136] ____ A separate meeting room on the ground floor will continue to accommodate those activities.

Because demand is likely to be high, please cancel a reservation promptly if your plans change. Desks that remain unoccupied for fifteen minutes after the reserved start time will be [137] ____ to other members. Library staff will demonstrate the booking system on opening day. Anyone who needs assistance before then can speak with a librarian [138] ____ visiting the information desk.
group.passageZh:
海港圖書館會員消息

依據會員調查結果，海港圖書館將把原地圖室改為安靜工作空間。施工將於六月三日開始，預計持續兩週。地圖館藏已移至二樓參考資料區，在正常開館時間仍 [135] ____。

新房間有十二張書桌，每張均設電源插座與可調式檯燈。會員每天可在線上預約最多三小時。室內不得通電話或進行團體討論。[136] ____ 一樓獨立會議室將繼續提供這些活動使用。

由於需求可能很高，若計畫有變，請即時取消預約。預約開始後十五分鐘仍無人使用的書桌，將 [137] ____ 給其他會員。開放當天，館員將示範預約系統。在開放前需要協助的人，可以在 [138] ____ 服務台時向館員詢問。
